string.text: At night, use lighting artifacts and flyers; you can find them in boxes after the wave
At night, light fires using matches; you can find them in boxes after the wave
Armor-piercing cartridges are twice as effective as regular ones against body armor; pay attention to what you’re shooting with
At night and in foggy weather, opponents also have poor visibility, so take advantage of that
On some levels, there are random caches; a message in the upper corner indicates that a full search has been completed
